missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Вертолёт' is a masculine noun in the nominative, the subject of 'летит'. 'Военный' agrees with it, and 'над городом' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Вертолёт' is the accusative direct object of 'увидел'; this inanimate masculine noun keeps the nominative form. 'Впервые' adds the sense of a first time.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Вертолёта' is the genitive form after 'у' in the possession frame. 'Мощный двигатель' is the nominative subject describing what it has.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'К вертолёту' uses the dative after 'к' to show approach toward an object. 'Медленно' describes how the pilot moved.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of transport. 'На вертолёте' uses the prepositional form after 'на' to express the means of travel. 'Домой' tells the destination.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Вертолётом' is the instrumental form showing the vehicle used. 'В больницу' is an accusative of direction marking the destination.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Вертолёта' is the genitive form required by 'без'. The sentence stresses dependence on the machine for the rescue.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Вертолёты' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'стоят'. 'Новые' agrees in the plural, and 'на аэродроме' adds the location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after numeral. After 'пять' the noun takes the genitive plural 'вертолётов', and 'новых' agrees in the genitive plural. A standard counting pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative superlative with genitive modifier. 'Вертолёт' is the nominative predicate noun, 'самый быстрый' is the superlative phrase, and 'армии' is a genitive of belonging.
